theologicalConcerns: ¶12 (English): "the Vedas, which He Himself created" is rendered faithfully as "जिन वेदों को उन्होंने स्वयं रचा". In the tradition the Vedas are eternal and not composed (apauruṣeya); ¶4 itself says they came forth from His breath. The owner may want to change the English to 'revealed' or 'brought forth'. This is not a fault in the translation.
